summary: Change contract gate, impact.security=affected olduğunda KYROX ortak güvenlik kataloğunun SEC-01..SEC-22 kimliklerini security.controls içinde required (çözümlenen test referansı) / na (somut gerekçe) olarak zorunlu kılar; scripts/verify-change-contract.mjs referansları çözer. Kurallar kyrox-platform/standards/security/SECURITY_PROGRAM.md'de.

impactAnalysis.notes: package.json yalnız contract:verify komutuyla bağlı; komut değişmedi. Keşfedilen gate testleri hedefli koşuldu; mevcut contract alanları ve path/domain duvarı değişmedi, yalnız security.controls doğrulaması eklendi. SYSTEM_CHANGE_GATE.md kural özeti ve SECURITY_PROGRAM.md bağlantısıyla güncellendi; diğer keşfedilen belgeler change-contract/gate adını referans verir, anlamları değişmez. F-004/F-005/F-006/F-009 (Stand audit numaraları; platform SECURITY_PROGRAM F-00x ile aynı değil) kapalı gate bulgularıdır; değişiklik gate'i sıkılaştırır, hiçbirini yeniden açmaz.

e2e.reason: Yalnız CI gate/tooling değişir; tarayıcıda görünen davranış yok.

risk.notes: Gate sıkılaşır: impact.security=affected olan sonraki değişiklikler SEC sınıflaması olmadan geçemez. not-applicable olan dallar etkilenmez.

migration.notes: Veri/şema geçişi yok; schemaVersion 2 korunur, security alanı eklenir.

rollback: Commit'i geri al; security alanı isteğe bağlı olduğundan eski contract'lar geçerli kalır.

SEC-01.reason: Gate tooling change; no protected API operation or permission check is added or changed.

SEC-02.reason: No organization-scoped data path, project, asset or export query is touched.

SEC-03.reason: No token, session, login or recovery code path is touched.

SEC-04.reason: Gate reads committed contract and test files only; it handles no secret values.

SEC-05.reason: No database connection, role or network access is involved in contract validation.

SEC-06.reason: git runs via execFileSync argument lists (no shell); contract data never reaches SQL or a shell.

SEC-07.reason: No upload or import endpoint; test references are only checked for existence in the repository.

SEC-08.reason: No server request input schema changes; change-contract JSON is CI-only repository data.

SEC-09.reason: No dependency or lockfile is added or changed by this gate change.

tests: test/systemChangeSecurityControls.test.js::verify CLI exits non-zero for a broken security test reference
test/systemChangeSecurityControls.test.js::verify CLI exits non-zero when affected security has no classification
test/systemChangeSecurityControls.test.js::verify CLI accepts a valid security classification

SEC-11.reason: No outbound network call or TLS configuration is involved in the gate.

SEC-12.reason: No backup, retention or restore path is touched.

SEC-13.reason: No identity, authorization or data event emission is added or changed.

SEC-14.reason: No user content is rendered; gate output is plain CI log text.

SEC-15.reason: No cookie is set, read or changed.

SEC-16.reason: No public endpoint or expensive user-triggered resource is exposed; gate runs in CI only.

SEC-17.reason: No HTTP response or browser security header is produced.

SEC-18.reason: No CORS configuration or cross-origin endpoint is touched.

SEC-19.reason: No cookie-authenticated state-changing request exists in a CI gate.

SEC-20.reason: No HTTP error response or authorization dependency is involved.

SEC-21.reason: Gate makes no server-side request to external URLs.

SEC-22.reason: No async job, retry, cancel or concurrent business operation is involved.
